Initial release of the smyx-reptile-excrement-analysis-analysis skill:

- Enables AI-powered visual analysis of reptile excrement (urate and feces) from high-definition enclosure camera images or video frames.
- Identifies urate (white/milky deposits) and quantifies its pixel area, normalizes by body length, and compares against historical baselines.
- Classifies feces morphology (formed, pasty, watery, bloody, etc.) and provides health prompts based on consistency.
- Integrates strict context exclusion (diet, brumation, breeding, substrate, and image quality) for accurate evaluation.
- Outputs detailed, actionable reports for early detection of kidney and gut issues, and supports querying of historical analysis data.
- Enforces robust workflow for user authentication (open-id acquisition and validation) before running analysis or accessing history.
